title: Drops
subtitle: The same rules as the source block
text:
Drops follow the source block's own rules. Glass needs Silk Touch to drop. Stone needs a pickaxe. A diamond-tier block needs the Diamond Precision Pickaxe.

Mining speed and blast resistance also come from the source blocks.

steps.text: To cut obsidian, ancient debris and other blocks that need a diamond tool, you need the Diamond Saw. The same is true for pieces already cut from those blocks.
A precision pickaxe also follows those rules when you mine a piece: a diamond-tier piece needs the Diamond Precision Pickaxe, and glass still needs Silk Touch.
